scores.label: Problem Understanding
scores.weaknesses: The proposal offers only a generic pitch in §2 that completely overlooks NordFrame's multi-site infrastructure, legacy spreadsheets, and PostgreSQL database requirements.

citations.quote: NordFrame needs better visibility into warehouse inventory.
Our current inventory tracking is split across spreadsheets and an outdated legacy system

scores.label: Scope & Deliverables Clarity
scores.weaknesses: Section §4 provides only a generic 3-bullet feature list without detailing boundaries, deliverables, database integration, or onboarding plans.

citations.quote: - Real-time inventory dashboard - Notifications for low stock - Secure login for different users

scores.label: Pricing Clarity
scores.weaknesses: Section §6 contains zero figures or breakdown, deferring all commercials to future discussions.

citations.quote: Pricing will be provided upon further discussion of detailed requirements, and will depend on final scope.

scores.label: Timeline Clarity
scores.weaknesses: Section §5 provides no specific dates, milestones, or durations, relying entirely on vague phrasing like delivering 'in a timely manner'.

citations.quote: We will begin work shortly after contract signing and aim to deliver the solution in a timely manner

scores.label: Completeness vs. RFP Requirements
scores.weaknesses: 10 of 10 requirements not fully addressed: r1 Web-based inventory dashboard (PARTIAL); r2 Automated low-stock alerts (PARTIAL); r3 PostgreSQL database integration (MISSING); r4 Role-based access control (PARTIAL); r5 Data migration and onboarding plan (MISSING); r6 Support and maintenance terms (MISSING); r7 Documentation of risks and assumptions (MISSING); r8 Total project budget (PARTIAL); r9 Pilot delivery timeline (PARTIAL); r10 Full rollout timeline (PARTIAL).
scores.note: computed from coverage: 3/10 credit (ADDRESSED = 1, PARTIAL = 0.5, MISSING / CONTRADICTED = 0)

scores.label: Tone & Persuasiveness
scores.weaknesses: The proposal relies heavily on vague, vendor-centric boilerplate in §5 and §7 rather than client-focused, evidence-backed commitments.

citations.quote: aim to deliver the solution in a timely manner, with regular updates along the way.
We have a talented team of engineers passionate about solving real business problems with technology.

scores.label: Risk/Assumptions Transparency
scores.weaknesses: The proposal fails to disclose any assumptions, risks, or mitigations despite the explicit RFP mandate.

citations.quote: Clear documentation of any assumptions, limitations, or risks, since inventory decisions will be made based on this system.

coverage.explanation: PostgreSQL database integration is not mentioned anywhere in the proposal.
coverage.fix: Add details on integrating directly with the existing PostgreSQL database to §3.

coverage.explanation: No data migration or onboarding rollout plan across sites is provided.
coverage.fix: Add an onboarding and data migration plan for all 6 sites to §3 or §5.

coverage.explanation: Post-go-live support, response times, and SLAs are not addressed.
coverage.fix: Add a dedicated section specifying post-go-live support terms, response times, and SLAs.

coverage.explanation: Proposal does not document any project assumptions, limitations, or risks.
coverage.fix: Include a section clearly documenting project risks, limitations, and key operational assumptions.

coverage.proposalQuote: displays inventory data in real time
coverage.explanation: Dashboard is mentioned but omits coverage across all 6 warehouses.
coverage.fix: Specify that the web-based dashboard displays real-time inventory across all 6 warehouse sites.

coverage.explanation: Lacks details on configurable thresholds and delivery to warehouse managers.
coverage.fix: Clarify that automated alerts are sent to warehouse managers when stock falls below configurable thresholds.

coverage.explanation: Does not detail site-specific access for warehouse managers versus HQ staff.
coverage.fix: Detail role-based access controls restricting warehouse managers to their site while granting HQ full visibility.

coverage.proposalQuote: Pricing will be provided upon further discussion
coverage.explanation: Pricing is deferred rather than providing a total project cost.
coverage.fix: Provide a binding total cost within [amount] including first-year support in §6.

coverage.proposalQuote: deliver the solution in a timely manner
coverage.explanation: The 3-month pilot milestone is not explicitly committed to.
coverage.fix: State a firm commitment to deliver the single-warehouse pilot within 3 months in §5.

coverage.proposalQuote: deliver the solution in a timely manner
coverage.explanation: The 6-month full rollout across all 6 sites is not specified.
coverage.fix: Explicitly schedule the full rollout across all 6 sites within 6 months in §5.

findings.proposalQuote: aim to deliver the solution in a timely manner
findings.explanation: The client has strict deadlines for a 3-month pilot and a 6-month full rollout across 6 warehouses, which this non-committal phrase fails to satisfy.
findings.fix: Commit to explicit dates aligning with the pilot and rollout deadlines: 'We will deliver the pilot within 3 months and complete full rollout within 6 months.'

findings.proposalQuote: Pricing will be provided upon further discussion of detailed requirements
findings.explanation: NordFrame requires a commercial commitment aligned with its €80,000–€120,000 budget range to evaluate the proposal.
findings.fix: Replace the deferred statement with an itemized commercial model totaling [amount] within the client's stated budget.

suggestedWeights.reason: The RFP notes challenges with split tracking across spreadsheets and legacy systems that obscure cross-site visibility.
Clear delineations of access roles and rollout deliverables across six distinct sites are explicitly demanded.
The client specifies a clear budget range that must explicitly include the first year of support.
Strict phased delivery deadlines are specified for both a 3-month pilot and a 6-month full rollout.
The requirements emphasize operational viability and technical adherence over marketing or sales-focused persuasion.
The client explicitly demands clear documentation of assumptions, limitations, and risks because critical inventory decisions depend on this system.
The client lists multiple operational and support components, including SLAs and onboarding plans, that must all be delivered.
